definition.def: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.
examples: ...a much reduced heat loss through external walls.

definition.def: External means involving or intended for foreign countries.
External means happening or existing in the world in general and affecting you in some way.
examples: Such events occur only when the external conditions are favorable.

definition.def: External experts, for example external examiners, come into an organization from outside in order to do a particular job fairly and impartially, or to check that a particular job was done properly. [mainly British]
examples: There must be externally moderated tests.

definition.def: If medicine is for external use, it is intended to be used only on the outside of your body, and not to be eaten or drunk.
